messages.author: Imre Haviland
messages.text: Grant 5488 is provider-issued — only Halyard's job touches it. Do not count it as tenant-revocable. 5501 is ours.

messages.author: Nienke Achterberg
messages.text: If someone wants the federation-wide emergency sign-out instead, that comes to me first. Not pre-approved.

messages.author: Beatriz Soriano
messages.text: Responder 2 AM on the 15th is the regulator session; leave it.
